change: reach_reward.py: replace the consecutive-streak dwell ramp (DWELL_BONUS_PER_STEP * held_steps / hold_steps_required, implicitly reset to zero whenever one step leaves the band) with a flat unconditional payment of DWELL_BONUS_PER_STEP on every in-band step; HOLD_COMPLETE_BONUS and all hold/threshold logic unchanged
hypothesis: The streak ramp makes partial competence nearly valueless: an isolated in-band step pays DWELL/100 (~0.005) while action cost drains up to ~0.1, so the oscillating policy that exploration noise actually produces earns almost nothing from occupancy - exps 28/29 showed rollout success_rate collapsing to exactly 0 tracking std decay (~60k steps) regardless of DWELL scale (0.5 vs 10.0), because occupancy only paid when a rare long noise-streak occurred, and by then PPO had already committed to the freeze basin behind a confidently-fit value function (explained_variance 0.97+). Paying DWELL_BONUS_PER_STEP on EVERY in-band step makes reward proportional to actual occupancy: a policy in-band half the time now earns half the max dwell stream instead of ~nothing, single noise-driven band entries immediately register as valuable outcomes for the value function from step 0, and hovering near/at the target becomes strictly more valuable than freezing far away, creating a continuous gradient along freeze -> hover -> hold. Expect rollout success_rate to stay nonzero through training instead of decaying to 0 with std (the signature failure of exps 28/29), curriculum stage advancement beyond stage 0 to become possible, and eval success above 0%; main risk is brief dip-in-and-out behavior being rewarded without true stability, which the untouched consecutive-step termination requirement still gates.
